scrapers.name: Miruro
scrapers.description: Miruro v2.9.0 - DEVICE FIX: restores the device-proven v2.7.0 base (fail-open post-filter, CDN hint rotation, ani.zip mal+ani dual-route, pipe circuit breaker, deadline) and grafts the 2026-09 MegaPlay API fix: getSourcesNew AES "enc" decrypt + signed master.m3u8 token. Root cause of the device zero-rows: v2.8.0 took CryptoJS from the harness-only __nvRequire shim which does not exist in the real Nuvio runtime (require("crypto-js") is what the app provides) - so every decrypt failed silently on devices. Serves anikoto:* catalog ids as before.

scrapers.name: Pencuri

Plays catalog rows DIRECTLY by navigating the site's real page or episode page (asian:pen-<slug> rows, zero title searching) and resolves TMDB ids by site search for everything else. v1.4.0 ENGLISH SUBTITLES on every row (opensubtitles-v3, parallel fail-soft lanes). v1.3.0 MULTI-SERVER FIX (user report: only 1 stream and its not playing - have 8 server): Streamtape /e/ pages carry TWO get_video links and the #robotlink DIV token (v1.2.0's pick) is a DECOY answering 403/500; the provider now evaluates the innerHTML expression (eval-free: string literals + chained .substring with JS semantics) to get the REAL token, which 302s to tapecontent.net (verified 720p + 1080p) and re-signs per request at play time; quality labels come from the embed page's own filename with zero extra requests. NEW StreamHG lane for hgcloud.to/hglink.to (2 of 8 servers, was an unparseable stub): loader rotates to audinifer.com whose radix-36 packed script unpacks to a signed master.m3u8 (206 verified); quality from the playlist RESOLUTION line. unpackPackedScript is now radix-aware (10..62). Dead-filler voe embeds (Big Buck Bunny placeholder, verified on the sample) are rejected via a placeholder guard. dedupeRows keys the FULL url (Streamtape file ids live in the query - the old query-strip collapsed both embeds into one row). Dood (playmogo/dsvplay) stays turnstile-aware: the gate is unconditional (verified desktop UA / mobile UA / cookie attempts), so gated pages skip in milliseconds. Lanes: MixDrop packed unpack to mxcontent.net mp4, Streamtape expression-token get_video, StreamHG signed m3u8, Dood pass_md5, Voe JS-redirect follow, inline probe for unknown hosts - all parallel, all fail-soft, all hasTimers()-guarded. Hermes-safe: no unescape/escape/btoa/atob.
